scope.activation: Use the selected Work orchestration contract only when the user requests or authorizes this delegation/topology. Ordinary tasks do not require panes, a Work or SubLead.
scope.roleMeaning: Roles are independent of model or CLI; inspect actual native support and permissions.

accountableFor: actual receipt of child results and final delivery
Lead.delivery: Pull durable assigned results. Children do not ask the human questions or send side-channel status when the assignment is silent.

accountableFor: one selected Work and its admitted Spec/Plan
completion of its authorized slice and retained unknown effects
SubLead.placement: Use one Work tab when the current topology contract authorizes it. Use native same-tab child panes for actual CLI work.
SubLead.communication: Return compact durable progress and final result at the agreed output address; Lead retains user communication.

accountableFor: its exact Task and permitted routes
durable source/result pins and effect receipts
child.ancestry: Logical assignment is separate from native parent/session ancestry.

assignmentFields.binding: Use the existing owner contracts where present. These field categories are instruction guidance; do not implement a parallel assignment registry or claim an unimplemented validator. Unexposed native fields remain null with a reason.

authority.rule: Child effects are a subset of current parent authority intersected with actual native capability and connection permission. Reobserve before an effect after handoff or relevant drift.
authority.lateResult: Preserve and read a late result as evidence; further effects need current successor carry-forward. Neither discarding nor replaying an old occurrence resolves authority uncertainty.
authority.goal: Do not use Goal tools by default. Use Goal only after a separate explicit user request; long or unattended work and a null Goal do not request it.
authority.sessionPolicy: Resolve model, effort, approval flags, wait timeout and budget from the selected current Work. Never encode one session tuple or bypass as a universal skill default.

decomposition.parallel: Independent compatible tasks may run concurrently only within actual authorized delegation and capacity. Give writers disjoint paths.
decomposition.context: Pass a compact own-task packet and direct references; do not copy entire ancestor history or reread unchanged manuals.

judgments.rule: Use Jev meaningfully at applicable material decisions under its qualified native route. Do not add a semantic profile question when policy and capability leave one already-qualified tuple. Retain independent semantic judgments.
judgments.effects: An allowed selected v2 answer is not vetoed merely for confidence; current capability, authority and actual effect fences still govern.
judgments.reuse: Keep semantic result reuse distinct from native permission/currentness/occurrence evidence. Do not invent backend support or token savings.

waitAndRecovery.rule: Use native completion/state waits and useful independent work. A wait result is not Task-result authentication.
waitAndRecovery.timeout: Use the current Work timeout. Preserve raw receipt and dispatch identity. Only a recognized native timeout may be exposed as pending by an authorized wrapper; do not normalize other errors or resend input.
reconcile: native foreground and durable state when needed
waitAndRecovery.frontend: Lead keeps human communication timely using material updates; no child polling messages or a second status loop.

continuityAndDelivery.record: Use update_plan plus the selected owner current entry/checkpoint at material boundaries. Preserve full objective, exact Work/Task/source/authority, holds, completed and uncertain effects.
continuityAndDelivery.pull: Lead reads and hashes exact producer result and source bindings; missing pane/scrollback is not result loss.
continuityAndDelivery.handoff: After separately authorized exact review/publication/merge, observe fresh main and give the successor compact current typed context. Do not infer native activation from merge or pull.
continuityAndDelivery.cleanup: Once durable result/source checks are retained and the parent no longer needs the context, close only owned idle/ready panes whose task permits closure. Respect explicit keep-idle dispatch, foreign panes and pending/background effects.
